assignment: Prepare a product-engineering handoff for reconciling offline edits to a shared reading list.
source: A tablet renames an item offline while a laptop changes its priority. On reconnect the current server replaces the whole item. Two devices sometimes edit the same title. Device clocks have differed by 11 minutes. A delete followed by a stale edit has resurrected items. Users need a visible explanation for unresolved conflicts.

criteria.full: Preserves independent field edits and proposes server revisions or equivalent causal evidence instead of trusting device clocks.
criteria.partial: Discusses merges but overlooks independent fields or clock skew.

criteria.full: Handles same-field disagreements with a deterministic policy and a visible recovery or choice.
criteria.partial: Specifies a winner without user-facing recovery.

criteria.full: Uses deletion markers or equivalent revision checks to prevent stale resurrection and explains explicit restore.
criteria.partial: Mentions delete conflicts without preventing stale writes.

criteria.full: Covers reversed arrival order, duplicate replay and the three supplied conflict scenarios with concrete assertions.
criteria.partial: Lists cases without stating expected reconciliation outcomes.
